messages:
Chloe Martin: seeing another customer report 403s on streaming w/ TS SDK in edge runtime. anyone else?
Aisha Rahman: yep, I have SUP-4821 earlier this month but that was python 401 after key rotate; curl worked.
Jordan Blake: I just filed SUP-4902 for Go SDK invalid_api_key when key comes from mounted file (newline).
Dev Patel: for edge streaming: suspect Authorization header merge. can you link ticket?
Chloe Martin: SUP-4884. customer proxy shows Authorization missing on failures.
Ethan Park: python one was .strip() on key; fixed in pr-891. might be similar footgun across SDKs.
Dev Patel: ok I'll patch TS streaming helper; will link PR when up.
Jordan Blake: FYI all these smell like key formatting / header construction. we should add guardrails in docs.
Aisha Rahman: agree. I’ll add note to support top issues once fixes ship.
